description: NaMgFe₅O₈ crystallizes in the trigonal R3m space group. Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to one Mg and six O atoms. The Na-Mg bond length is 2.10 Å. There are three shorter (2.19 Å) and three longer (2.49 Å) Na-O bond lengths. Mg is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, three equivalent Fe, and four O atoms. All Mg-Fe bond lengths are 2.30 Å. There are three shorter (1.89 Å) and one longer (1.99 Å) Mg-O bond length. There are three inequivalent Fe sites. In the first Fe site, Fe is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to one Mg and six O atoms. There are a spread of Fe-O bond distances ranging from 2.02-2.41 Å. In the second Fe site, Fe is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four O atoms. There are three shorter (1.94 Å) and one longer (2.10 Å) Fe-O bond length. In the third Fe site, Fe is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four O atoms. There are three shorter (1.92 Å) and one longer (2.05 Å) Fe-O bond length. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to one Na and three Fe atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four Fe atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to one Mg and four Fe atoms. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Mg, and three Fe atoms.
